initialization: step2/gated_aug checkpoints, each trained on attachment2 train only
coalition_sampling: uniform proper subsets 0..6; otherwise complete inputs
explanation_target: fixed original predicted class probability (ensemble mean), plus separate continuous intensity Shapley
primary_baseline: modality absent: features zero, observation mask false, recomputed availability statistics
sensitivity_baseline: training-only feature medians with original observation masks; a different representation-replacement game

ig.reference: standardized zero, P/O/quality fixed; representation-level ranking only

local.ranking: largest signed sum of IG over contiguous equal-length token windows
local.validation: delete raw text tokens before frozen encoding; audio/vision rows zero with observation false
local.keep_control: retain selected window within the same modality, other modalities unchanged
local.special_confirmation: evaluate every same-length sliding window; report IG-selected and strongest observed deletion separately
local.probability_drop_warning: negative deletion effect is counter-evidence, never relabeled supporting

faithfulness_validation_samples: all 728 validation samples; primary main-modality and all-modality summaries

stability.seeds: all three predictors, target fixed to ensemble original class

timing.method: CTC forced alignment of original full transcript; fast tokenizer offsets to token slots
timing.source: step1 fixed wav2vec2 assets; no proportional t/50 video timestamps
timing.feature_correspondence: task-provided aligned slot correspondence + within-word repeat audit; physical times estimated, not official ground truth

stage_boundary: all model/baseline/window rules locked before special predictions
